## Outreach brief

- **Lewis & Clark (San Diego):** **Qwadere Lovell**, Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions / admissions counselor for San Diego County. **qlovell@lclark.edu** · **503-713-1203**. [Lewis & Clark’s California-counselor listing](https://college.lclark.edu/admissions/staff/counties/) (the live official site’s former deep URL now returns 404, but its current official search listing identifies Lovell for San Diego).

- **Hunter Silberman MSW, Fall 2026:** **Application: March 1; supporting documents: March 15.** This applies to the Two-Year Full-Time, Bank Street dual-degree, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency entries in Silberman’s Fall table. [Official deadline page](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/).

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate offerings:**
  - **Master’s:** MBA; MS in Management; MS in Strategic Finance; Master of Public Management; MS in Nursing; MA in Mental Health Counseling; online MA in English; online MA in History; and online MS in Criminal Justice and Public Safety.
  - **Graduate/post-baccalaureate certificates:** Leadership; Business Analytics; Alcohol and Drug Counseling; Biology; Accounting (post-baccalaureate); Business Fundamentals (post-baccalaureate); Advanced Medical Imaging Technology (post-baccalaureate); and Informatics (post-baccalaureate).
  - IU Kokomo describes its official graduate inventory as including master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and post-baccalaureate work: [Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html).

- **UCSF glioblastoma trials recruiting in Northern California** (UCSF’s wording is “open to eligible people”; locations below are from its trial list):
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — **San Francisco, California**; adults 18+.
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **San Francisco, California and other locations**; adults 18+.
  3. Also useful: **MOAB Trial — Identify Optimal Atezolizumab Biomarkers in Recurrent Glioblastoma** — **San Francisco, California and other locations**.
  [UCSF’s live glioblastoma-trials page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma) currently reports 16 studies open to eligible people. Eligibility and recruiting status can change, so confirm with the study team before outreach.

- **Oral Roberts University student activities:** ORU’s current Student Association terminology is **Director of Student Experience** rather than “Director of Student Activities.” The person listed is **Augustine Mendoza**; official posted contact: **augiemendoza@oru.edu**. [ORU Student Association Cabinet listing](https://oru.edu/current-students/my-campus-life/campus-life/student-association-cabinet/) (the current official search result shows the name, title, and email). No direct phone was posted in the material I found.

- **EDF Energy graduate programme — salary-review wording:** The exact wording associated with EDF graduate recruitment is: **“Biannual salary reviews: We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you’ll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.”** In other words: review eligibility is twice yearly for the first three years, and it is conditional on passing probation; it is not worded as an automatic pay rise. EDF’s current official [Graduate Careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers) is the primary programme page (it currently focuses on programme areas and live vacancies rather than displaying that salary-review clause on the overview page).

I left the principal evidence pages open in separate tabs, including the official Hunter deadline page, IU Kokomo graduate-programmes page, UCSF trial list, and EDF graduate-careers page.
